new_value: Fixed via 64-bit queue-local time base: extend_now64() low-32 forward-difference extension, deadline_expired() now 64-bit compare, enqueue computes deadline_ms64 = now_ms64 + (deadline - now), deadline_valid_future() rejects absolute deadlines beyond next half-range (delta 0 or > INT32_MAX). Host test test_stale_deadline_not_resurrected_after_half_range passes; suite 37/37 under ASan+UBSan and TSan.
